headline: This law sets noon on January 6, 2015, as the day the 114th Congress starts its first session.
what_it_does: Congress normally begins a new session on January 3 under the Constitution's default schedule, but this law moves the start date to Tuesday, January 6, 2015. It sets the time as noon. The measure is a joint resolution that became law after being signed.
when_it_takes_effect: The first session of the 114th Congress was set to begin at noon on January 6, 2015.
